title: Poppuni Racers, game I've tried to make several times over a decade ago, made in a week
author: JoeOfTex
selftext:
**My Gamedec Journey:**

Making games use to take me at least 3-6 months to develop.  Then I find no one likes it and I feel cheated out of my wasted time.  

Now I can prototype and push ahead faster if I like the idea, and now see if you also like the idea.  Only wasting 1 week of development time.  This game was in no way done in a single prompt, this is the culmination of thousands of prompts.

**The Game:**

The characters are called Poppuni.  "Poppu" is Japanese for "Pop" and Uni well, because of the single tire.   I've tried making this game twice before.  Even used it as my Senior Project at university.   Now, I've been able to actually make it and make it fast.   The hardest part about this type of game is iterating through the physics and settings to get it just right.  

It is pure racing, using stunts to build up your rush meter.
